BiblicalUsage: Yâqâr means valuable, precious, costly. David took the crown of the king of Rabbah with its precious stones, and Solomon's builders brought great costly stones to lay the foundation of the house.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that what is precious is worth weighing, and God counts the cost of His house.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
